            0% {

            background-repeat: no-repeat;

        }

        @media (orientation: portrait) {
            #logoSpinner {
                display: none;
            }

        @keyframes logoSpinnerX {
            0% {

                width: 15vmax;
                opacity: 0.9;

                left: 84vw;
                z-index: 5;

            75% {

                width: 6vmax;
            }

            100% {
                opacity: 0.5;
                left: calc(8vw - 5vmax);
            }
        }

        @keyframes logoSpinnerY {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0deg);
                top: 10%;
            }

            33% {
                transform: rotate(720deg);
                top: 37%;
            }

            66% {
                transform: rotate(-720deg);
            }

            100% {
                transform: rotate(0deg);
                top: 10%;
            }
        }

        @keyframes logoSpinnerZ {
            to {
                filter: hue-rotate(360deg);

        .scroll-animate {
            /* Initially hide the content by collapsing its height */
            max-height: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            /* Hide content that overflows the zero height */
            margin-top: 0;
            /* Remove initial margins that might take space */
            margin-bottom: 0;
            /* Remove initial margins that might take space */
            padding-top: 0;
            /* Remove initial padding */
            padding-bottom: 0;
            /* Remove initial padding */

            opacity: 0;
            /* Still start completely transparent for fade-in */
            transform: translateY(20px);
            /* Still slide up for effect */
            visibility: hidden;
            /* Hide it from screen readers and pointer events */

            /* Transition all properties for a smooth effect */
            transition: max-height 0.8s ease-out,
                opacity 0.6s ease-out 0.2s,
                /* Delay opacity slightly */
                transform 0.6s ease-out 0.2s,
                /* Delay transform slightly */
                margin 0.8s ease-out,
                padding 0.8s ease-out,
                visibility 0.8s;
            /* Transition visibility last */
        }

        /* Class added when the element is in view */
        .scroll-animate.visible {
            overflow: visible;
            /* Set a large enough max-height to ensure content is fully visible */
            /* You can use a very large value like 1000px or more, or calculate it with JS */
            max-height: 39999px;
            /* Adjust this value if your content is taller */

            /* Restore original margins and padding */
            margin-top: 40px;
            margin-bottom: 40px;
            padding-top: 20px;
            padding-bottom: 20px;

            opacity: 1;
            /* Make it fully visible */
            transform: translateY(0);
            /* Move it to its original position */
            visibility: visible;
            /* Make it visible to screen readers and pointer events */
        }

        @keyframes loadingGamesAnim {

            border-radius: 0 0 10vmin 10vmin;
            z-index: 10;
            width: 100%;
            height: 40%;
            left: -5%;
            opacity: 0.5;
            background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4), white, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));

            animation: wobble 2.02s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

            -webkit-text-stroke-color: green;
            animation: wobble 2.03s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

            animation: wobble 2.04s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

            -webkit-text-stroke-color: purple;

        .ggOrangeX,
        .ggLimeX,
        .ggBlueX,
        .ggPurpleX {
            animation: none;
        }

        @keyframes wobble {
            0% {

                margin-left: 1vw;
            }

            100% {
                margin-left: -1vw;
            }
        }

        @keyframes shake {

            10%,
            90% {
                transform: translate3d(-1px, -1px, 0)
            }

            20%,
            80% {
                transform: translate3d(2px, 1px, 0)
            }

            30%,
            50%,
            70% {
                transform: translate3d(-4px, -3px, 0)
            }

            40%,
            60% {
                transform: translate3d(4px, 3px, 0);
            }
        }

        @keyframes vshake {

            10%,
            90% {
                transform: translate3d(0, -1px, 0)
            }

            20%,
            80% {
                transform: translate3d(0, 1px, 0)
            }

            30%,
            50%,
            70% {
                transform: translate3d(0, -3px, 0)
            }

            40%,
            60% {
                transform: translate3d(0, 3px, 0);
            }
        }

        @keyframes brightFlash {

            0%,
            40%,
            80% {
                filter: brightness(0) invert(1);
            }

            20%,
            60%,
            100% {
                filter: none;
            }

                if (newWelcomeText.substr(randCharIndex, 1) != welcomeText.substr(randCharIndex, 1)) {
                    newWelcomeText = setCharAt(newWelcomeText, randCharIndex, testChar1);
                }

                }

        function pageLoaded() {
            var finished = new Date().getTime();
            var loadingTime = 1 + finished - start;

            setTimeout(function () {

                //acquisition analytics
                if (pageViews == 1 || pageViews == 5 || pageViews == 20) {
                    gtag('event', ('User Acquisition : ' + pageViews), {
                        'event_category': 'Acquisition',
                        'event_label': 'User Tally'
                    });
                }

                if (gamePlays == 1 || gamePlays == 5 || gamePlays == 20) {
                    gtag('event', ('User Acquisition : ' + gamePlays), {
                        'event_category': 'Acquisition',
                        'event_label': 'User Tally'
                    });
                }

                var dBugOutput = deviceCategory + " ds:" + deviceSpeed + " sw:" + screen.width + " sh:" + screen.height + " sr:" + (Math.round(aspectRatio * 100) / 100) + " plt:" + loadingTime + " scl:" + scriptsLoadable + " rnd:" + userRandom + " gfx:" + gfxPerformance + "|" + gfxPerformanceCategory + " pv:" + pageViews + " gp:" + gamePlays + " du:" + dressupCounter + " " + build;
                dBugText.innerHTML = dBugOutput;
            }, 2000);
            //dBugOutput += "<br>" + navigator.appVersion + " --- " + navigator.userAgent + " --- " + navigator.appName + " --- " + parseFloat(navigator.appVersion) + " --- " + parseInt(navigator.appVersion, 10);

            if (Math.random() > 0.99) {
                loadingTime = Math.round(loadingTime / 1000);
                if (loadingTime > 19) {
                    loadingTime = "20+";

                gtag('event', ('Homepage Loaded : ' + loadingTime), {

                    gtag('event', 'Facebook', {

                    });
                }

            }, 10000);

        function shuffleArray(array) {
            for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
            }
        }

        function getImageDimensions(imageUrl) {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                const img = new Image();

                img.onload = () => {
                    resolve({
                        width: img.width
                    });
                };

                img.onerror = (error) => {
                    reject(error);
                };

                img.src = "https://" + window.atob(imageUrl);
            });
        }

                "One day we found some old Victorian story books in a dusty leather suitcase. Some of them were so good we read them out for you as bedtime stories - find them in 'Friv Daily' at the bottom of the page.",
                "When you click on a game below, your computer sends a request to our servers to send the game to you. The information travels as beams of light along fibre optic cables under the sea. But the light can only travel about 50 miles / 70 kilometres or so before it becomes too faint, so there are amplifiers called 'repeaters' dotted all the way along the thousands of miles of cables to keep the data flowing!",
                "Once you have played a certain number of games you will see a poo emoji at the <i>bottom</i> of this page. Mostly he likes to sleep. If you click on him, he, well - let's just say he's been clicked on literally MILLIONS of times!",
                "Lots of families around the world have no computers at all, or maybe just one basic phone or tablet. We work really hard to make Friv run well even on smaller or slower machines.",
                "If someday you want to learn how to make games yourself, you could study computer programming, and hopefully mathematics too. But don't forget art, music and design - they make games come alive!",
                "Since we started Friv, literally hundreds of fake Friv sites have appeared, many even ripping off our logo. Thank you, and well done for choosing the real Friv. Accept no imitations!",
                "We want the games on Friv to be suitable for all ages, and that's why you won't find swearing in any of them.",
                "Most of the games on Friv aren't made by big companies. A typical game is made by just one or two people, often working from home. Many are made for love rather than money, and we think it shows!",
                "In the early days of video games, computers were slow and didn't have much memory. Often, they could only display 4 or 8 colours on the screen at once. Now computers can display 16,777,216 colours on the screen at once!",
                "We think that playing games should be free for everyone, and we get upset when users elsewhere are overcharged for upgrades / loot boxes / skins etc. Friv will be free forever, for everyone!",
                "If you counted all the hours users spend on Friv, it would add up to thousands of lifetimes. This crazy fact keeps us determined to make the experience the best it can be.",
                "In the old days, computer games were programmed in assembly language which looked like [mov r0, r10 | bl 0x51dd4 | movt r0, #152 | cmp r0, r5] and the games would only run on the type of computer they were written on. Nowadays, the games here are written in Javascript and will run on nearly any device with a browser. Hurrah!",
                "Friv is popular around the world, but we actually get most hits from Latin America - countries like Peru, Colombia, Mexico and Brazil.",
                "A lot of users make videos of themselves playing on Friv, and upload them to YouTube. It's a great way to practice valuable presentation, planning, narration, and multitasking skills. Search for OBS (Open Broadcast Software) to find free software to do it.",
                "At Friv we try not to be sexist. That's why from the start we chose purple for our background colour - it's halfway between blue and pink! And we hate racism. That's why wherever there is a person of colour in any of the games, we choose them for the thumbnail image.",
                "If you search for '250' on Google you will find Friv. That's because our old Flash menu had 250 games, and people still like to search for that number to get here. Try it!",
                "We always try to add two or three new games a week - sometimes more, sometimes less - so keep checking back!",
            ];

            if (touchDevice) {

                frivTipsArray[1] = "Congratulations! You may not know it, but you are a tech early-adopter! You are playing games in your mobile browser. No need for the App Store or Google Play!";
                frivTipsArray[2] = "The future of playing games is in the mobile browser - that way there are no big corporations deciding what you can play. It's the free and open internet, not just what's allowed in the app stores.";

                for (i = 0; i < frivTipsArray.length; i++) {
                    frivTipsArray[i] = frivTipsArray[i].replace(/click/g, "tap");

            if (frivTipNumber == frivTipsArray.length - 1) { //never choose last friv tip (for analytics)
                frivTipNumber--;
            }

        }

        function displayFrivTip() {
            var chosenFrivTip = frivTipsArray[frivTipNumber];

        //console.log("x: " + navigator.connection);
        //console.log("y: " + navigator.mozConnection);

            console.log('          rtt: ' + navigator.connection.rtt + 'ms');

            // Upper bound on the downlink speed of the first network hop
            console.log('  downlinkMax: ' + navigator.connection.downlinkMax + 'Mb/s');

            // Effective connection type determined using a combination of recently observed rtt and downlink values
            console.log('effectiveType: ' + navigator.connection.effectiveType);

            // True if the user has requested a reduced data usage mode from the user agent
            console.log('     saveData: ' + navigator.connection.saveData);

            var connectivity = navigator.connection.effectiveType;

            gtag('event', connectivity, {
                'event_category': 'Connectivity',
                'event_label': 'Debugging'
            });

            if (androidVersion > 0) {
                gtag('event', androidVersion, {
                    'event_category': 'androidVersion',
                    'event_label': 'Debugging'
                });
            }

        }


        //HOUSE PROMO

                }
            }, 1000);
        }

Si tú o algún miembro de tu familia puede, por favor déjanos una reseña en <a href='https://es.trustpilot.com/review/www.friv.com' rel='noopener noreferrer'>Trustpilot</a> ...esperamos poder ganarnos tus estrellas. ¡Muchas gracias!<br>⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐", //https://tinyurl.com/frivtpes
            "pt": "Esperamos que goste de jogar os jogos aqui no Friv.         //DISPLAY ELEMENTS ONLY WHEN USERS SCROLL TO IT
        ///////////////////////////////////////////////
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            const animatedElements = document.querySelectorAll('.scroll-animate');

            function isInViewport(element) {
                const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
                // Adjust this check if you want the animation to start earlier/later
                return (
                    rect.top <= (window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight) * 0.8 // Starts when 80% of element is in view
                );
            }

            function handleScroll() {
                animatedElements.forEach(element => {
                    // Only process if the element is not already visible
                    if (!element.classList.contains('visible')) {
                        if (isInViewport(element)) {
                            element.classList.add('visible');
                            // If you only want it to appear once, you could do this:
                            // element.dataset.animated = 'true'; // Mark as animated
                        }
                    }
                });

            // Add scroll event listener
            window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);

            // Initial check in case elements are already in view on page load

            handleScroll();

            // Re-check on resize in case layout changes
            window.addEventListener('resize', handleScroll);
        });

            console.log("Portrait or first time visitor...");

                }
            }

                }, 20000);
            }
        });

        function showPromoOverlay() {
            const overlay = document.getElementById('promo-overlay');
            if (!overlay) return;

            // Make the overlay visible
            overlay.classList.add('visible');
            overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');

            // Handle click event anywhere on the overlay
            overlay.addEventListener('click', handleOverlayClick, { once: true });
        }

        function handleOverlayClick() {
            const overlay = document.getElementById('promo-overlay');

            // Launch destination in a new tab
            window.open('https://www.gamui.com', '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');

            // Remove/hide overlay
            if (overlay) {
                overlay.classList.remove('visible');
                overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            }
        }

        }
